name: agent-worksystem-builder
description: Build complete intelligent systems through continuous requirements grill, adaptive exploration and evidence-backed software and intelligence orchestration.

interface.longDescription: Build complete intelligent systems through continuous requirements grill, adaptive exploration, architecture design, implementation and independent verification. One coordinator composes five focused Skills. Targets choose ordinary software architecture and optional interactive/noninteractive intelligence without mandatory AWB DAG or business storage. Includes versioned contracts, recoverable construction state and general verifiers. Python 3.11+ for the shared runtime; MCP is optional. Experimental preview; validation scope and limits are documented in the repository.
defaultPrompt: Grill my requirements, explore options and build the complete intelligent system I need.
设计整体软件架构和智能层，持续探索、实现、核验并保留决策。

publication.release_notes: 0.2.0-alpha.2 separates the single-plugin upload archive from the CLI marketplace bundle and adds one self-contained, host-adaptive Agent Skill containing all five modules. Existing CLI/MCP remain compatible; previous version assets are preserved. Hosted upload acceptance, behavioral qualification and official approval are recorded separately.

zh-CN.subtitle: 自动编排与实现完整智能系统
zh-CN.description: 通过持续需求 grill、自适应探索与评估—创造—验证—决策循环，构筑完整智能系统；整体软件架构与可选交互、非交互智能层分别设计。总控组合五个模块，支持版本化契约、恢复与通用核验。0.2.0-alpha.2 提供独立插件上传包及自包含通用 Skill，实际验证范围见仓库文档。
